'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Dnieper campaign (2022–present)|Dnieper campaign]]
****[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] withdraw from the village of [[Krynky]] in [[Kherson Oblast]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-07-18/ukraine-withdraws-from-strategic-position-in-southern-region (Bloomberg)]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***Five people are killed and three others are injured in [[Russia]]n attacks on villages in the [[Donetsk region]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attacks-kill-five-eastern-donetsk-region-ukraine-says-2024-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****Both the [[Gaza Health Ministry]] and the [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Israeli Health Ministry]] report traces of type 2 [[polio]] in Gaza's sewage system, caused by "severe overcrowding" and Israel's blockade of hygiene products from entering the enclave. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240718-poliovirus-detected-in-gaza-sewage-gaza-israel-health-ministries (France 24)]
***At least five [[Palestinian]]s are killed and fifteen others are injured in [[Israel]]i airstrikes on the [[Nuseirat]] and [[Bureij|al-Bureij]] refugee camps in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://aje.io/2wbw71?update=3056104 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/5-killed-in-israeli-airstrike-on-gaza-refugee-camp/3279240 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**The death toll from the protests in [[Bangladesh]] increases to 32, with the government shutting down internet access across the entire country, and protesters setting fire to the headquarters of the main [[Bangladesh Television|state broadcaster]] in [[Dhaka]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20240718-state-tv-hq-set-ablaze-death-toll-rises-student-protests-roil-bangladesh (France 24)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**Two [[India]]n soldiers are killed and four others are injured in an [[improvised explosive device|IED]] attack by [[Communist Party of India (Maoist)|Maoists]] in [[Chhattisgarh]], India. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/2-jawans-killed-4-injured-in-ied-attack-by-maoists-in-chhattisgarhs-bijapur-101721271198950.html (''The Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.indiablooms.com/world-details/SA/42984/bangladesh-snaps-internet-services-as-anti-quota-protests-turn-violent-killing-39.html (India Blooms)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*''[[Stegosaurus]]'' skeleton [[Apex (dinosaur)|Apex]] is [[auction]]ed for $44.6 million (£34 million) at a [[Sotheby's]] auction in [[New York City]], [[United States]], the most ever paid for a fossil. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0358njg6z6o (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2024 Nigerian general strike]]
**The [[Nigeria Labour Congress]], the [[Trade Union Congress of Nigeria (2005)|Trade Union Congress]], and the [[Nigerian government]] agree on a new [[minimum wage]] of [[Nigerian naira|₦]]70,000 ([[United States dollar|US$]]43) per month, ending prolonged negotiations amid high [[inflation]] and a [[Hard currency|weakening currency]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nigerias-main-labour-unions-agree-new-minimum-wage-minister-says-2024-07-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Egypt]]'s [[Suez Canal]] reports a 23.4% drop in revenues attributed to disruptions in [[Red Sea]] shipping over the past year, marked by attacks from [[Yemen]]'s [[Houthi]] militia on [[Israel]]i-linked vessels. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/07/18/suez-canal-s-income-falls-amid-yemen-houthi-attacks- (Al Arabiya)]
*The [[Saudia|Saudia Airlines]] group signs a binding sales agreement with [[Lilium GmbH]] to purchase 50 electric [[Lilium Jet]]s, with the option to purchase 50 more. [https://www.flightglobal.com/business-aviation/saudia-firms-order-for-up-to-100-lilium-jets/159165.article (Flight Global)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are killed after a Robinson R44 crashes near [[Chagda]], [[Russia]]. [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/402733 (Aviation Safety Network)] 
*Twelve cars of the [[Dibrugarh–Chandigarh Express]] train derailed in [[Gonda, Uttar Pradesh|Gonda]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]], resulting in at least two dead and 25 injured.

'''International relations'''
*[[Sudan–United States relations]], [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[United States]] announces it will give an additional $203 million to help civilians affected by the war in [[Sudan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/07/18/us-to-give-another-203-million-in-humanitarian-aid-for-sudanese (Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in South Korea]]
**The [[Supreme Court of South Korea]] rules that [[same-sex relationship|same-sex couples]] are eligible to receive the same health insurance benefits as heterosexual couples. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-supreme-court-same-sex-rights-a15a537133dcfaa0d7ffc753f798ca63 (AP)]
*[[2024 Nice arson attack]]
**Seven people from the same family, including three young children and a teenager, are killed, another is injured and thirty suffer smoke inhalation in an [[arson]] attack in [[Nice]], [[France]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c51yjpmk70go (BBC News)]
*The [[Southwark Crown Court]] sentences five [[Just Stop Oil]] activists, including co-founder [[Roger Hallam (activist)|Roger Hallam]], to [[His Majesty's Prison Service|prison]] terms ranging from four to five years for organizing protests that [[Traffic obstruction|blocked]] the [[M25 motorway]] in [[London]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], in 2022. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/07/18/climate/just-stop-oil-prison-sentence-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*Five people, a mother and four children, are killed in a mass shooting near [[West Blocton, Alabama|West Blocton]], [[Alabama]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/five-killed-alabama-bibb-county-f18573c9aa369d99ab729960adb88d18 (AP)]
*A [[2024 Harehills riot|riot]] erupts in the suburb of [[Harehills]], [[Leeds]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c047xg5gedko (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Ursula von der Leyen]] is re-elected as [[president of the European Commission]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw5yg6dp0gxo (BBC News)]
